title: Coefficient and pullback square on unevaluated Hom-complex homology
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a scheme morphism [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $G$ and $G^{\prime}$ abelian etale sheaves on $X$ and $Y$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and $R,R^{\prime}$ arbitrary injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Let $L=f^{-1}$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], $v:LG\to G^{\prime}$, and $\psi:LR\to R^{\prime}$ an integer-indexed chain map commuting with augmentations via $v$. Let $\alpha:\mathbb Z_Y\to L\mathbb Z_X$ be the inverse constant-sheaf comparison, with $\mathbb Z_X$ and the evaluation-independent resolution class comparison as in [def-weil-pbc-ext-resolution-sections-iso]. Let $c$ be the map of Hom complexes [lem-weil-pbc-ext-pullback-hom-complex] sending a degree-$n$ cochain $a$ to $\alpha;L(a);\psi^n$. For $p\in\mathbb N$, the Ext/resolution class equivalence followed by the inverse class-to-Hom-homology isomorphism and $H^p(c)$ equals $H^p(v)\circ\operatorname{cohomologyMap}(f,G,p)$ [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] followed by the target Ext/resolution class equivalence and its inverse class-to-Hom-homology isomorphism. This statement is before sections evaluation: it contains no global-sections complex or comparison to its homology.

source.place: Tags 06XR, 01F8 (equations 01F9 and 01FA), and 08J6; step 1 of lem-weil-pbc-row-integer-sections

proof.text: Represent an Ext class by a resolution cohomology class and then a single cocycle a. The chain-map equation for ψ and exact inverse image show α;L(a);ψ is a cocycle. Homotopy.ofEq of the augmentation equality supplies the comparison homotopy. Apply the individual coefficient-cocycle formula to identify its Ext class with precomposition by α, exact-functor pullback, and postcomposition by v.

For the map of short complexes induced by c, take left homology map data γ. Its inclusion equation identifies γ on cocycles with c, and its quotient equation π;γ_H=γ_K;π sends the class of a to the class of α;L(a);ψ. Transport through the chosen left homology isomorphisms. Surjectivity of CohomologyClass.mk and Cocycle.fromSingleMk extends this calculation to every Ext class. The definition of c is homPullbackMap, so no sections evaluation is used.

Rewrite the coefficient-map and pullback formulas Sheaf.H.map_apply and cohomologyMap_apply. Abelian-group morphism extensionality turns the pointwise cocycle calculation into the stated forward square. The degree-zero and zero-object cases obey these same formulas.

proof_origin.note: Split off the unevaluated Hom-complex square from step 1. The evaluation square is a separate intermediate item; their categorical combination is proved in the parent. The existing chosen-resolution square does not have arbitrary R,R′ or v.

lean.statement:
theorem ceExtHomologySquare {X Y : Scheme.{uNatural}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})
    (G' : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})
    (R : InjectiveResolution G) (R' : InjectiveResolution G')
    (v : (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).obj G ⟶ G')
    (ψ : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj R.cochainComplex ⟶ R'.cochainComplex)
    (hψ : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map R.ι' ≫ ψ =
      (HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).hom.app G ≫
      (CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).map v ≫ R'.ι')
    (p : ℕ) :
    R.extAddEquivCohomologyClass.toAddCommGrpIso.hom ≫
        (leftHomologyData _ R.cochainComplex (p : ℤ)).homologyIso.inv ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (SheafPullbackResolution.homPullbackMap
            (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f)
            ((upperStarConstantSheafIso AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).inv.app
              (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{uNatural + 1} ℤ)))
            R.cochainComplex R'.cochainComplex ψ) (p : ℤ) =
      AddCommGrpCat.ofHom ((Sheaf.H.map v p).comp (cohomologyMap f G p)) ≫
        R'.extAddEquivCohomologyClass.toAddCommGrpIso.hom ≫
        (leftHomologyData _ R'.cochainComplex (p : ℤ)).homologyIso.inv
